title: Opposites in the Ocean
text: The ocean is home to creatures that are complete opposites of each other. A whale is enormous, while a seahorse is tiny by comparison. A dolphin swims swiftly through the water, but a starfish moves sluggishly along the sand. Some fish stay near the bright, sunny surface, while others live in the dark, gloomy depths. Scientists study every one of these creatures closely, from the fastest swimmers to the slowest, to understand how they all share the same ocean home.
